subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` as the supported operator opt-in for bounding deferred context-engine maintenance, with the proposed fence and checkpoint semantics after timeout?
rationale: The branch is intentionally conservative about upgrade compatibility, but choosing a new public configuration surface and the resulting abandoned-worker contract is product and ownership policy rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
options.body: Keep unbounded behavior as the default and merge once the context-engine owner accepts the timeout, fence, and persistence-checkpoint semantics.

options.title: Move timeout policy to an owner plugin
options.body: Keep core generic and require context-engine plugins to expose their own bounded maintenance policy if that better matches ownership.

options.title: Reject this configuration surface
options.body: Retain current behavior and pursue a different generic liveness mechanism without adding a compaction setting.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in timeout contract
recommendation.body: Keep unbounded behavior as the default and merge once the context-engine owner accepts the timeout, fence, and persistence-checkpoint semantics.
